sub_site: clear cell renal cell carcinoma tissue (FFPE)

evidence.quote: Clinical samples from patients with ccRCC were collected from the Second Affiliated Hospital of Harbin Medical University
Paraffin-embedded tissue blocks were sent to Oebiotech for 2bRAD-M microbiome sequencing
The majority of microbes in the negative control samples (paraffin) were Acinetobacter and Aeromonas
qualitative and quantitative analyses, and false-positive filtering

notes: Paraffin negative controls sequenced (Acinetobacter, Aeromonas in controls; not recorded). Top-50 genus heatmap only in Fig 1C/F; text names genera characterising PAZ-S vs PAZ-R groups. No contaminant removal described beyond 2bRAD-M false-positive filtering. Also bacterial culture, FISH, IF staining.
